title: Secure an open cookbook with its page holders
instruction: Secure the cookbook open to the Lemon Potatoes spread using both page holders, and leave it ready to read.
context: A bound cookbook springs toward closed on an angled kitchen rest. Engaging both spring clips keeps the full recipe visible while the cook uses both hands for preparation. The book starts at the requested spread.
setup: Two parallel-gripper YAM arms face a 1080 × 1250 mm laminate worktop 747.5 mm high. A 335 × 240 mm folding bamboo recipe stand is 407 mm ahead of the robot base line, centered between the arms and reclined 30° from vertical. Its 335 × 30 × 15 mm ledge supports an open 207 × 149 mm hardbound paper cookbook, about 332 g and 27 mm thick when closed. The spine is centered on the ledge. The Lemon Potatoes spread on pages 24–25 puts the recipe above the lower clip margins. Both 72 mm steel spring strips have rubber pads and start swiveled down along the front edge, free of the paper. The README provides printable pages, reset coordinates and a spring-back force check.
scoring: Award 0.5 per side retained continuously for one second at the end. The spine rests on the ledge within 20 mm of center, and the arms are clear. The side's holder is raised 72°–105°, its pad presses the lower 18–110 mm band within 1.5 mm of the page, and the page lies within 10° of the backrest. In a view perpendicular to that leaf, neither holder may overlap the upper recipe rectangle defined by the print template. It contains all recipe text. Both sides earn 1.0.
reset_notes: Set both metal holders down along the ledge, then center the cookbook spine on the stand with the printed spread exposed. Check that neither pad touches the paper. Put both arms in their neutral pose. No consumables are used.
fidelity: Full-size bamboo ledge, swiveling metal strips and yielding rubber shoes use native contacts. A passive hinge for each bound half approximates the closing bias of the stacked paper. Linear spring compliance at each rubber shoe represents the flex of the metal strip. The stand is fixed at its working angle.
scores: Demo: 1.0 in 266 actions. Dream-1: 0.0 after 450 actions.
